"Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')"}], "description": "`Unarchive` in `pkg/utils/zip.go` joined each archive entry name with the destination directory via `filepath.Join` and wrote the result without checking whether the resolved path stayed under the destination. A zip entry named
  `../../tmp/evil` therefore landed at `/tmp/evil`. An attacker who could control a `Package.Spec.Source.URL` or `Deployment.URL` archive could induce the fetcher (running as the per-environment pod's `fission-fetcher` sidecar) to write
  files anywhere that process could reach: into other tenants' `/packages/<ns>/` directories, into mounted secret/config volumes, or into the fetcher's own binary.

  ### Affected

  - Project: `github.com/fission/fission`
  - Versions: all up to and including v1.24.0
  - Audited commit: `647c141`
  - Component: `pkg/utils/zip.go` (`Unarchive`)
  - Configuration: default; triggered when the fetcher downloads and extracts a zip archive

  Fix section (paste into the Fix / Patches field)

  Fixed in [v1.25.0](https://github.com/fission/fission/releases/tag/v1.25.0) by:

  - [PR #3444](https://github.com/fission/fission/pull/3444) (commit [`55704aca`](https://github.com/fission/fission/commit/55704aca1b8d6f45bc7c7c2e4805c7e14875ec0f)) — `Unarchive` now opens an `os.Root` on the destination, validates each
  archive entry name (rejects absolute paths and `..` traversal), and refuses symlink entries up front. The `os.Root` confines every `mkdir` / `create` to the destination in the kernel.

  Regression coverage: `TestUnarchiveZipSlip` in `pkg/utils/zip_test.go` exercises parent-traversal, absolute-path, and symlink entries.", "epss": {"percentage": 0.00301, "percentile": 0.21546}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-q6vm-xqc9-v3ff", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-07-28T20:16:52Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q6vm-xqc9-v3ff", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-q6vm-xqc9-v3ff"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-50567"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-06-10T18:17:13Z", "published_at": "2026-07-28T20:16:52Z", "references": ["https://github.com/fission/fission/security/advisories/GHSA-q6vm-xqc9-v3ff", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-50567", "https://github.com/fission/fission/pull/3444", "https://github.com/fission/fission/releases/tag/v1.25.0", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q6vm-xqc9-v3ff"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/fission/fission/security-advisories/GHSA-q6vm-xqc9-v3ff", "severity": "high", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/fission/fission", "summary": " Fission: Zip Slip in pkg/utils/zip.go:Unarchive allows fetcher to write outside the destination directory", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-07-28T20:16:53Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-q6vm-xqc9-v3ff", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "1.25.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "go", "name": "github.com/fission/fission"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "<= 1.24.0"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
